sections.heading: Coimbatore's Aavin Dairy and the Three-District Milk Load
paragraphs: Milk for Coimbatore, Tiruppur and the Nilgiris is processed by the Coimbatore District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union (Aavin). In August 2026 the union reported local procurement of about 110,000 litres a day against a processing requirement of up to 310,000 litres a day for the three districts, with the gap covered by bulk milk from the Karnataka Milk Federation. Demand had risen when private dairies raised retail prices, and agents increased daily orders by 10,000 to 15,000 litres.

A plant running close to its limit has little time for cleaning between runs. That is where the inside of the tube matters: a smooth, drainable bore cleans in fewer and shorter CIP cycles and gives the packaging lines back their time.

When a plant brings in bulk milk from another federation, its reception bay handles more tanker unloadings a day and more cleaning cycles between them. Reception remains a mechanically polished 304L duty, but the hoses and adapters at the unloading bay are worth replacing with clamp-end fittings that can be cleaned with the line.

sections.heading: Pumps, Poultry and Food: Who Else Buys Hygienic Tube Here
paragraphs: Coimbatore is known as the Pump City of Asia, with pump and motor making among its largest engineering activities, and more than 50,000 engineering units work in and around the city. It is also a centre for poultry and processed meat, with companies such as Suguna Foods, and has some of the oldest large flour mills in the south.

Most of that work does not need electropolished tube. It does where a Coimbatore fabricator builds pump skids, CIP sets or process modules for dairy, pharma and food customers, and where meat and food plants clean product lines in place. In those cases the tube on the skid is the part the end user's auditor looks at, so it should arrive with traceable certificates and a measured finish.

sections.heading: Specifying for a Coimbatore Skid or Dairy Line
bullets: Dairy product and CIP return lines: electropolished 304L or 316L; plain milk lines can stay mechanically polished.
Skids for pharma customers: 316L to ASME BPE with SF4 bore and the customer's Ra limit.
Food and meat processing: 304L for neutral products, 316L for brine, marinades and hot CIP.
Match the tube series to the fittings and pumps on the skid before ordering.

bullets: Whether the tube is for your own plant or for equipment you build for a customer, and who that end user is in industry terms.

sections.heading: Delivery to Coimbatore and the Western Belt
paragraphs: Coimbatore is supplied by road from Mumbai, with dispatch and transit confirmed in writing for each order, and every electropolished length is capped and sleeved.
